peripherals.name: SYSTEM
peripherals.description: Common and board platform register window.

registers.name: VERSION
registers.description: Read-only register and command interface version; current value 0x000f0000 identifies version 15.

registers.name: SYSTEM_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only live summary of core/render activity, sample flow, output readiness, and external-memory request/response handshakes.

registers.name: COMMON_EVENT_FLAGS
registers.description: Sticky event flags for underrun, sample drop, render deadline miss, and observed memory response; write one to clear, with same-cycle events taking priority.

registers.name: PIPELINE_LATENCY_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only most recently reported render latency and traced external-memory response latency, both in clocks.

registers.name: UNDERRUN_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of audio underrun pulses since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: SAMPLE_DROP_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of rendered samples dropped by the output path since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: RENDER_DEADLINE_MISS_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of render deadline miss pulses since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: CURRENT_SAMPLE
registers.description: Read-only start-frame index of the most recently admitted render block.

registers.name: CMD_FIFO_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only command FIFO occupancy, parser/dispatcher activity, and nonzero command/stale-generation error summaries.

registers.name: MEM_RESPONSE_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of traced external-memory response pulses since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROL
registers.description: Renderer diagnostic control. Writing CLEAR resets common event/counter/maximum state, command error/stale counts, sample-window counters, and the I2S FIFO minimum level without resetting voices or playback state; reads return zero.

registers.name: PIPELINE_LATENCY_MAX
registers.description: Maximum completed render latency and traced external-memory response latency since reset or DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROL.CLEAR, both in clocks.

registers.name: AUDIO_FIFO_DIAGNOSTICS
registers.description: Live output FIFO level, minimum level since reset or diagnostic clear, and playback-started state.

registers.name: AUDIO_LEAD
registers.description: Live rendered-minus-played stereo-frame lead of the I2S output path.

registers.name: COMMAND_ERROR_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of malformed or unsupported parsed commands since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: STALE_GENERATION_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of rejected stale-generation command/state updates since reset or diagnostic clear.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only compressor enable, look-ahead priming, nonzero current reduction, and delay-fill level summary.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_GAIN_REDUCTION
registers.description: Read-only applied linked-channel gain reduction in unsigned centibel Q12.20.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_TARGET_GAIN_REDUCTION
registers.description: Read-only detector target gain reduction for the current analyzed frame in unsigned centibel Q12.20.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_DETECTOR_PEAK
registers.description: Read-only zero-extended linked peak magnitude max(abs(left), abs(right)) from the current pre-compressor signed-25 mix frame.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_MAX_GAIN_REDUCTION
registers.description: Read-only maximum applied gain reduction since core reset in unsigned centibel Q12.20.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_MAX_DETECTOR_PEAK
registers.description: Read-only maximum linked pre-compressor peak magnitude observed since core reset.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_INPUT_FRAME_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of stereo mix frames accepted by the look-ahead compressor since core reset.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_OUTPUT_FRAME_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of valid stereo output frames emitted after the fixed look-ahead delay since core reset.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_COMPRESSED_FRAME_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of emitted frames with the compressor enabled and nonzero applied gain reduction since core reset.

registers.name: COMPRESSOR_SATURATION_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of left/right PCM16 channel clamps after compressor and master gain since core reset.

registers.name: EFFECT_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only spatial-effect enable/activity, chorus-history, reverb-line-valid, and configuration-clamp summary.

registers.name: EFFECT_INPUT_FRAME_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of stereo frames accepted by the spatial-effect chain since core reset or effect clear.

registers.name: EFFECT_OUTPUT_FRAME_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of spatial-effect output frame handshakes since core reset or effect clear.

registers.name: EFFECT_SATURATION_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of signed-25 left/right channel clamps in the dry/wet effect-return mixer since core reset or effect clear.

registers.name: EFFECT_MAX_PROCESSING_CYCLES
registers.description: Read-only maximum spatial-chain clocks from input acceptance to mixer output valid since core reset or effect clear; value is in bits 15:0.

registers.name: CHORUS_HISTORY_LEVEL
registers.description: Read-only number of valid stereo frames currently stored in chorus history; value is in bits 15:0.

registers.name: CHORUS_LFO_PHASE
registers.description: Read-only current chorus LFO phase in unsigned Q0.32.

registers.name: CHORUS_SATURATION_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of signed-25 left/right channel clamps while writing chorus history since core reset or chorus clear.

registers.name: REVERB_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only reverb pre-delay occupancy in bits 15:0 and valid delay-line mask in bits 23:16.

registers.name: REVERB_SATURATION_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of signed-25 reverb channel clamps since core reset or reverb clear.

registers.name: REVERB_MAX_PROCESSING_CYCLES
registers.description: Read-only maximum clocks used by the reverb processing FSM since core reset or reverb clear; value is in bits 15:0.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_REQUEST_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of sample-window client requests accepted since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_HIT_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of accepted requests served from a valid per-voice sample window since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_REFILL_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of window misses that requested a complete per-voice window refill since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_FALLBACK_READ_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of window misses handled as one-line fallback reads since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_MEMORY_READ_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of external line-read requests issued by the sample window since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_EVICTION_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of valid per-voice windows replaced by refills since core reset.

registers.name: SAMPLE_WINDOW_STALL_CYCLE_COUNT
registers.description: Read-only saturating count of cycles with a client request blocked after sample-window metadata initialization since core reset.

registers.name: PLATFORM_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only Smart Artix presence, error summary, DDR/MIG handshake, SD initialization, asset-loader, card-presence, and SD high-speed status.

registers.name: PLATFORM_ERRORS
registers.description: Read-only packed SD error, asset-loader error/state, SD retry count, and SD recovery error diagnostics.

registers.name: PLATFORM_BYTES_LOADED
registers.description: Read-only number of SF2 payload bytes written to DDR by the current asset-load session.

registers.name: PLATFORM_SF2_SIZE
registers.description: Read-only SF2 payload size in bytes decoded from the validated WTSF image header.

registers.name: PLATFORM_CURRENT_LBA
registers.description: Read-only SD logical block address currently selected by the asset loader.

registers.name: PLATFORM_DDR_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only DDR calibration/reset, live MIG application-interface handshake, and raw 12-bit MIG device-temperature status.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_CONTROL
registers.description: DDR debug command control: START launches one operation when ready, WRITE selects direction, and CLEAR clears sticky DONE/ERROR; reads return the last accepted WRITE direction in bit 1.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_STATUS
registers.description: Read-only DDR debug aperture presence, live ready/busy, sticky completion/error, and last accepted operation direction.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_ADDR
registers.description: Read/write byte address for the next one-beat DDR debug operation; START rejects addresses that are not 16-byte aligned or outside the MIG address range.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_BYTE_ENABLE
registers.description: Read/write 16-bit byte-enable mask for the next DDR debug write; reset value enables all bytes and an all-zero write mask is rejected at START.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_DATA0
registers.description: DDR debug data bits 31:0: writes stage the next write beat, while reads return the corresponding lane of the last captured DDR read beat.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_DATA1
registers.description: DDR debug data bits 63:32: writes stage the next write beat, while reads return the corresponding lane of the last captured DDR read beat.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_DATA2
registers.description: DDR debug data bits 95:64: writes stage the next write beat, while reads return the corresponding lane of the last captured DDR read beat.

registers.name: DDR_ACCESS_DATA3
registers.description: DDR debug data bits 127:96: writes stage the next write beat, while reads return the corresponding lane of the last captured DDR read beat.
